category.name: File transfer
category.description: Send, receive and share large files through browser links or client delivery portals.
category.audience: Individuals, client-facing teams, creative studios and organizations exchanging files externally.
category.audienceRationale: File delivery spans individual sharing and recurring client work across industries; specialized high-volume routing serves production teams.

pricing.note: Paid Starter/Ultimate/Teams confirmed in official help. Current entry price could not be verified because pricing page requires JavaScript; do not substitute third-party or app-store prices.

On-Demand USD $0.25 per GB leaving MASV after 15 GB free monthly; not a flat monthly subscription. Storage beyond five days costs extra. Annual commitments/pre-buy and custom enterprise options also offered.

oss.name: copyparty
oss.classificationReason: MIT self-operated server; README documents browser uploads, permissions and sharing without a paid edition or license gate. No official managed hosting offer identified; linked read-only demo is not hosting.
serviceLimitations: Operator supplies storage, bandwidth, reachable server, TLS and maintenance; no managed delivery network or SLA established.

health.rsx: Authenticated rsx analyze: score 6.5; balanced policy pass; central captured result.

oss.name: ProjectSend
oss.classificationReason: GPL v2 self-hosted core; licensing page explicitly includes client delivery, accounts, permissions, branding, storage and public links without artificial caps. Tier A applies to this complete open core; Cloud fleet operations and optional alternative commercial licensing do not restrict it.
serviceLimitations: Cloud-only services: billing/subscriptions, fleet provisioning, managed backups/restore, monitoring/uptime SLA, email deliverability and cross-organization administration.
Self-hosted operation requires infrastructure, backups and email configuration; Cloud service quotas are not software license gates.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Replace selected browser send/download workflows with own server and password-protected expiring share links, optionally allowing recipient uploads. up2k resumes chunked uploads. Existing WeTransfer links/accounts do not migrate automatically; re-upload files and issue new links. Operator owns capacity and service availability.

Persistent client accounts/groups and upload-back portals suit recurring client delivery; core includes public links and file expiration. Requires deployment and recipient access setup; export/download original files and re-upload, replacing old links. No verified automatic WeTransfer importer or equivalent anonymous send experience.

Candidate for operator-run large-file upload/download endpoints: up2k chunks/checksums and resumes uploads with no software file-size limit. MASV accelerated cloud egress, destination routing, integrations and managed availability need separate replacement; throughput depends on own server/network. No MASV package/history migration verified.

uncertainties: WeTransfer current web entry price unverified: official pricing page returned a JavaScript error.

GPL v2 identified by pinned LICENSE and official licensing page; GPL-2.0-only used because no project-specific or-later grant verified.
No SLA, hosted acceleration or automatic migration parity inferred for either open server. ProjectSend large-file resumability not verified; no MASV edge asserted.
